# W Rome Signature Suites

## Suites

In W Rome’s suites, design moves between past and present, where the architecture of the palazzo is reinterpreted through a contemporary lens. Open-plan living, refined materials, and thoughtful details create spaces that feel both expressive and calm. Private terraces extend the experience outward, offering a moment to pause above the city’s ever-evolving atmosphere.​

### Penthouse Suite

Set on the top floor, the 241 sqm Penthouse Suite offers a more expansive way to experience Rome. Spacious by design, with distinct living areas that unfold seamlessly, it brings together refined materials and intuitive details that balance comfort with expression. An extensive private terrace extends the experience outdoors, creating a setting that shifts effortlessly from quiet moments to more social...See More occasions, always connected to the city below.​See Less

## More Than a Suite

Step into a different way to stay in the hotel’s largest suite. Designed for both downtime and social moments, it opens onto a private terrace with sweeping views across the city, from sunset into night. Inside, generous living spaces and layered interiors create a setting that feels expressive, effortless, and entirely your own.​

Virtual Tour

## Your Suite Experience

Elevate your stay with a selection of curated benefits designed to make every moment seamless, social, and effortlessly enjoyable:​

​Private round-trip transfer (to/from main airport or train stations)​

Daily breakfast experience at Giano or via in-room dining​

Complimentary parking​

Signature aperitivo at W Lounge​

20% off food & beverage across all outlets​

Laundry service: 2 items per day (excluding dry cleaning)​

Exclusive W Rome welcome amenity​

​Each detail is thoughtfully designed to enhance your experience, so you can focus on enjoying the city, your way.​

### Supreme Suite

Perched on the fifth floor, the Supreme Suite is a true scene-stealer. A King-size signature W bed, bold design, and daring artworks define the space, where heritage meets contemporary cool. The spacious living area is made for unwinding or entertaining, while the expansive terrace offers iconic views of Rome’s skyline—perfect for soaking up the city’s energy in style.

## The Living Is Wow

Designed for both relaxation and celebration, the Supreme suite's outdoor haven boasts a stylish living and dining area, inviting you to sip, savor, and soak up the city's energy from sunrise to starry nights. With bespoke Italian furnishings and an effortless al fresco flow, the terrace sets the stage for unforgettable moments.

## Suite Life on a Mega Scale

The fusion of old and new is redefined with distinct flair here, but the W Suites offer more than just visually striking design. The plush sofa in the living area expands to accommodate extra guests, allowing up to 4 people to relax in total comfort. Some suites feature double bathrooms, while others boast open-air spaces, ensuring privacy and convenience for all.

Book Now

## Space Redefined

For those who seeking even more space, select W Suites can effortlessly connect to adjacent rooms, offering a seamless and expansive retreat. This feature makes them the perfect choice for families, groups, or anyone looking for the ultimate in privacy and convenience, without compromising on luxury.

## Elevate Your Stay

The blend of classic and contemporary design elevates every detail of the Urban Suites. Wraparound leather headboards, theatrical drapes and art pieces capture the flair and energy of the city, while the addition of a comfy sofa and coffee table up the ante on comfort. Some Urban Suites also come with sizeable outdoor private garden or terrace adding an extra touch to the experience.
